business_problem: Unilever needed to understand complex biology, microbiome behavior, and underserved consumer cohorts more effectively so it could develop differentiated beauty and personal care products faster and with fewer physical experiments.
solution_summary: Unilever uses an in-house R&D stack built around AI, machine learning, big data, the Polycultural Centre of Excellence (PCOE), and measurement technology to turn biological and consumer data into new product formulations. Teams capture clinical and consumer data on melanin-rich skin tones, textured hair, sweat, wetness, and the skin microbiome, then aggregate those large datasets for analysis. AI is used to interrogate complex biology and microbiome data, while machine learning mathematically models results that would previously have required many more physical experiments. Insights from the PCOE and microbiome analysis are applied to launches such as Vaseline Radiant X, Dove and Shea Moisture products, and whole-body deodorants. Sophisticated digital tools also supported development of Dove’s MicroMoisture technology, and digitally integrated Unilever plants manufacture the resulting complex formulas on Unilever sites.

solution_components.name: AI
solution_components.role: AI is used to interrogate complex biology and microbiome datasets so scientists can identify patterns that inform new product technologies.

solution_components.name: machine learning
solution_components.role: Machine learning mathematically models results beyond the experiments Unilever physically runs to support faster product development.

solution_components.name: big data
solution_components.role: Large biology, clinical, and microbiome datasets provide the evidence base that Unilever analyzes for R&D decisions.

solution_components.name: Polycultural Centre of Excellence (PCOE)
solution_components.role: The PCOE studies and captures data on melanin-rich skin tones, textured hair, and underserved consumer needs for Beauty & Wellbeing launches.

solution_components.name: measurement technology
solution_components.role: New clinical measurement technology captures data that helps Unilever understand growing demographics and their product needs.

solution_components.name: MicroMoisture technology
solution_components.role: This patented formulation technology was created with sophisticated digital tools for Dove’s serum shower collection.

data_flow: Clinical measurements and consumer-relevant observations from melanin-rich skin, textured hair, sweat, wetness, and skin microbiome studies are gathered through the PCOE and other R&D programs. Unilever aggregates these datasets, uses AI to interrogate complex biology patterns, and applies machine-learning models to infer results beyond the experiments it physically runs. Scientists then translate those insights into formulations and process designs that are manufactured in Unilever’s digitally integrated plants and released through brands such as Dove, Vaseline, Rexona, and Shea Moisture.
business_outcome: Unilever reports faster, smarter innovation, fewer required experiments, differentiated products for underserved consumer groups, premium product development, and growth in categories such as whole-body deodorant.
architecture_clues: The PCOE focuses on melanin-rich skin tones and textured hair for Beauty & Wellbeing in North America.
Unilever says it has one of the largest compendiums of microbiome data in the world.
Machine learning is used to model results that previously would have required more physical experimentation.
MicroMoisture products are manufactured exclusively on Unilever sites.
Unilever says its plants are fully integrated to manufacture the complex MicroMoisture formula.
evidence_quotes: “The AI technology we have allows us to interrogate complex biology data to find that ‘butterfly’ that allows us to invent new technology.”

“In the past we might have had to carry out 1,000 experiments to get the data we needed for a new ingredient. Now we can do a fraction of that – and machine learning helps us to mathematically model the rest.”

“At the PCOE we’re entirely focused on studying and capturing data around melanin-rich skin tones, textured hair and what consumers from these under-served cohorts really need and want from their products.”

“Our plants are fully integrated to make sure they can manufacture this complex formula, and Unilever is the only place where MicroMoisture is made.”
